newsitem.title: USA: Rockwell to acquire Cirrus group.
newsitem.headline: Rockwell to acquire Cirrus group.

text.p: Rockwell International Corp on Tuesday said it signed a definitive deal to aquire the wireless semiconductor products group of Pacific Communications Sciences Inc, a unit of Cirrus Logic Inc.

Rockwell will pay $18.1 million, and the group will become a part of the the wireless communications division of Rockwell Semiconductor Systems. Based in San Diego, Pacific Communications' wireless group employs about 125 people.

It is the leading supplier for Japan's advanced digital cordless Personal Handy Phone System (PHS), with about 50 percent of the four million PHS user-subscriber base using its handset semiconductor products.

The wireless group also has unveiled Digital European Cordless Telephones (DECT) and is developing pager-chipset solutions for personal Air Communications Technology (pACT), a narrowband two-way messaging system.
